facts.text: I live on grassy plains in Africa, and a few in India.
I live with my family in a group called a pride.
I rest for about 20 hours every day!
My roar can be heard 8 kilometers away!
The girl lions work together as a team to hunt.
Boy lions grow a big, fluffy mane.
Baby lions are called cubs, and they are born with spots.
People in parks across Africa and India help keep us safe.

toys.caption: ROAR! You could hear me from far away!
My shoulder is about as tall as you!
